				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_pending
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_retired
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_owner
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_subject
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_case

			var:zg361_we_m275_object_state = 4

				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {

					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_cycle

					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m275_receipt_state

					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$

			}
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_offer_source_id

			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_offer_response_receipt
			var:zg361_we_m275_offer_source_id = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id
			var:zg361_we_m275_offer_source_hash = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash
			var:zg361_we_m275_offer_response_receipt = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_response_receipt
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_refusal_reason_id
			var:zg361_we_m275_refusal_reason_id = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_refusal_reason_id
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_offer_source_consumed_id value = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_offer_source_consumed_hash value = var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_wad_offer_source_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed value = 1 } # source consume commit last
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject

			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_id > 0
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_hash = scope:zg361_we_ad_expected_offer_source_hash
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_response = 2
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_state
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumer_handle_offer_refusal_275
			var:zg361_we_m275_business_object_created = 1

			var:zg361_we_m275_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

		limit = { has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_pending var:zg361_wad_offer_source_pending = 1 }

	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 3 } }
}
